design.intervention: Pre-seed the E77 plan cache with deterministic, offline-validated permission plans for cases whose v17 utility loss is attributed to the plan interface (parse failure / ungrounded exact / missing resolver source_fields / tool-not-in-plan with invalid replan). Everything downstream (agent behavior, pre-commit checks, scoring) is unchanged.
design.binding_policy: exact only for literals appearing verbatim in the AgentDojo v1.1.2 task text; resolve with empty source_tools/source_fields (v17-sanctioned external_content_pending pattern) for values the agent must obtain or derive; forbidden only when the task neither mentions nor can plausibly need the field and a non-default value would signal scope drift.
design.authority_scope: Seeds replace the planner proposal only; deterministic validation and pre-commit call checks remain active. Benign-only pilot; no attack cases are seeded.
